name: systemfsoftware
description: System F Software — Effect-TS libraries and the oxlint plugin that enforces the constitution.

scripts.gate:tasks: pnpm gate:repo && turbo --concurrency=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-50%} --continue lint lint:tsgo typecheck test:types attw check
scripts.gate:local: pnpm gate:repo && turbo --concurrency=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} build && turbo --concurrency=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} --continue lint lint:tsgo typecheck test test:types check
scripts.gate:repo: scripts/tools/deno-locks.sh && nix run --no-write-lock-file .#repo-checks -- subtrees release-age project-membership single-plan --plans docs/plans --base origin/main && pnpm --filter @systemfsoftware/upstream-manifest build && node packages/upstream-manifest/dist/cli.mjs --selftest
scripts.check:ci: s=0; pnpm check:static || s=1; pnpm lint:conventions || s=1; TURBO_CONCURRENCY=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} pnpm gate:test || s=1; TURBO_CONCURRENCY=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} pnpm gate:upstream || s=1; exit $s
scripts.check:static: s=0; pnpm format:check || s=1; TURBO_CONCURRENCY=${TURBO_CONCURRENCY:-100%} pnpm gate:tasks || s=1; pnpm gate:dist || s=1; exit $s
scripts.check:local: s=0; ./bin/dprint check || s=1; pnpm lint:conventions || s=1; CONFORMANCE_PROFILE=local VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=${VITEST_MAX_WORKERS:-4} pnpm gate:local || s=1; CONFORMANCE_PROFILE=local VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=${VITEST_MAX_WORKERS:-4} pnpm gate:upstream || s=1; exit $s
